'''Captain Rothynn''' is a [[human]] ghost located in the [[Master's Cellar]] in [[Deadwind Pass]]. Along with his twin brother Andreon, he was a part of Karazhan's tower guard, and both were granted a [[Mark of Karazhan]] upon being accepted into the guard.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|60+|The Mystery of Karazhan V}}</ref>

==Objective of==
* Drops [[Mark of Karazhan]] for {{questlong|Alliance|60+|The Mystery of Karazhan V}} and {{questlong|Horde|60+|The Depths of Karazhan V}}.
